typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	sFilename as string (),
	tblEndurCommoditiesTradeEventsValidatedStaging_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		event_date as string,
		deal_tracking_num as string,
		toolset as string,
		ins_type as string,
		name as string,
		short_name as string,
		internal_external as string,
		type_of_event as string,
		trade_time as string,
		trader_name as string,
		executed_by as string,
		marketer_name as string,
		trade_event_category as string,
		action_interval_days as string,
		booked_to_new_by as string,
		new_validated_by as string,
		tran_num as string,
		reference as string,
		last_name as string,
		title as string,
		validatedAmended_by as string,
		validateAmend_reason as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> DailyTradeEventsReportValidated	source(output(
		filename as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> checkarchivetopreventdupesLKPTABLE
DailyTradeEventsReportValidated derive(FileName = toString($sFilename),
		LoadDate_drv = toString(currentTimestamp())) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn derive({Copy of deal_tracking_num} = deal_tracking_num,
		{Copy of trader_name} = trader_name) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion,checkarchivetopreventdupesLKPTABLE lookup(DerivedColumn@FileName == checkarchivetopreventdupesLKPTABLE@filename,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> checkarchivetopreventdupes
checkarchivetopreventdupes filter(!isMatch()) ~> checkarchivetopreventdupes0
checkarchivetopreventdupes0 sink(input(
		Action_Interval_Days as integer,
		EventDate as string,
		Internal_External as string,
		Reference as string,
		Trade_Time as string,
		FileName as string,
		Ins_Type as string,
		File_LoadDate as string,
		Executed_by as string,
		Marketer_Name as string,
		last_name as string,
		Title as string,
		Booked_to_New_By as string,
		Toolset as string,
		Name as string,
		Deal_Tracking_Num as string,
		Type_of_Event as string,
		New_Validated_By as string,
		Short_Name as string,
		Trade_Event_Category as string,
		Trader_Name as string,
		tran_num as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Action_Interval_Days = action_interval_days,
		EventDate = event_date,
		Internal_External = internal_external,
		Reference = reference,
		Trade_Time = trade_time,
		FileName,
		Ins_Type = ins_type,
		File_LoadDate = LoadDate_drv,
		Executed_by = executed_by,
		Marketer_Name = marketer_name,
		last_name,
		Title = title,
		Booked_to_New_By = booked_to_new_by,
		Toolset = toolset,
		Name = name,
		Deal_Tracking_Num = deal_tracking_num,
		Type_of_Event = type_of_event,
		New_Validated_By = new_validated_by,
		Short_Name = short_name,
		Trade_Event_Category = trade_event_category,
		Trader_Name = {Copy of trader_name},
		tran_num),
	partitionFileNames:[($tblEndurCommoditiesTradeEventsValidatedStaging_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> tblEndurCommoditiesTradeEventsValidatedStaging
